label: SYSTEM_RECOMMENDATION
limitations: events and facts are observations; every explanation is a hypothesis, never a diagnosis of cause
no probability, score or confidence is given; hypotheses are listed in a fixed order, not ranked
absence of a record is never evidence of absence; supplied records are taken as stated, not verified (SIMULATED in a simulated scenario, otherwise UNVALIDATED)
only sustained excursions beyond the limit you set are diagnosed; brief excursions are reported as facts

data evidence SIMULATED: statements hold only for these data; UNVALIDATED: the rules were checked on SIMULATED logs only; no real fault outcome has been compared with them, and every explanation is a hypothesis, not a diagnosis
next checks are ranked as a work priority (relevance, effort, evidence value), not by any confidence in an explanation
refusal_reason: no temperature limit was given (--upper-threshold / --lower-threshold): ColdSense does not decide what temperature is abnormal
